narrative: On the part. Egeon's roll on the table, creased at the first speech. The king's leaf is face down and is not turned. No tally of anyone else's lines on this paper. On the part. The roll rolled again. No margin of nineteen, no goose, no other man's total. The pen is not taken up.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Read the roll and put it down.

entities.name: Errors
entities.context: Shown on part in Egeon, at both ends
